title: Ground-truth preset definition
description: One entry of the simulator's jump menu. The simulator jumps to sim_ts minus lead_in_min and announces the jump with a gt-marker; the user interface shows label verbatim. Never a message on its own: presets travel inside a gt-presets document.

label.description: Menu text, shown verbatim; an en dash and an abbreviated month, as in the README.

kind.description: What the preset demonstrates: a labelled failure, its precursor, an unscored diagnostic case or normal operation.

sim_ts.description: Target instant in the data clock; the interesting moment the preset is named after.

lead_in_min.description: Simulated minutes of context before sim_ts; the jump lands at sim_ts minus this value.

failure_id.description: The failure of the ground-truth table this preset shows, or null when the preset is not scored.

note.description: Why the preset exists, for the operator of the demonstration.
